decisions.reason: Premium support is a low-cost add-on built on the firm's existing service staff and keeps customers loyal. Unless it clearly falls short of aspirations, the firm has little reason to search for other uses of those resources.

The version manager had its own page for two years and was named alongside the established security and recovery tools. This suggests it is part of the core platform and meets aspirations, so it is likely to be kept.

The data processing contract tool was a response to the 2018 GDPR rules and demand may have declined since then. It is cheap to maintain and fits a compliance-oriented customer base, so the firm's slack allows it to stay on the market.

Scalable hosting for agencies extends the core hosting business and was featured on the home page. The firm is likely to keep it while agency demand meets aspirations based on its past hosting performance.
